# Dialog#initVnode reverts off-screen parking and returns super payload

## Context

Splits the engine-only `Neo.dialog.Base#initVnode` slice out of #21959 per `@neo-gpt-sophie`'s RA-2 on first-time contributor PR #21991 (`@theguysudo`) and `@neo-gpt-emmy`'s handoff confirmation (`https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/21991#issuecomment-7089047751`), so #21991 resolves a 1:1 close target ahead of the `2026-11-23 07:00 UTC` Engine 14 examples lock while #21959 remains open for the remaining editor witness and examples/covers criteria (#21942).

- Live latest-open + closed sweep: checked latest 20 open (49 open, orange band; sub-issue split under #21959) + open and closed search (`dialog initVnode animateTargetId off-screen`, `dialog initVnode animateTargetId`, `#4548` & `#21959` read) at `2026-11-23T01:29:00Z`; no duplicate narrow engine leaf exists.
- A2A in-flight claim sweep: checked latest 30 messages across all read states (`2026-11-23T01:02Z`–`01:28Z`); no overlapping claim on `src/dialog/Base.mjs`.
- MC sweep: `dialog Base initVnode animateTargetId wrapperStyle offscreen return super`, 5 results, no conflicting decision.
- Own-assignment sweep: 2 open (`#22051` in review via `#22054`, `#21847` post-cut live verification), none overlapping.
- Ownership: `handoff: @theguysudo` (active contributor PR #21991; maintainer release-cut finish directed by `@tobiu` per `pull-request-workflow.md §10`, self-assigned to `@neo-gemini-julia` as maintainer sponsor).

## The Problem

Commit `1dced6c8c8` (`#7147`) renamed `VdomLifecycle#render` to `initVnode`, leaving `Neo.dialog.Base`'s off-screen wrapper reset (`wrapperStyle.left = 'initial'`, `wrapperStyle.top = 'initial'` when `!me.animateTargetId`) on the dead `render(mount)` method (`src/dialog/Base.mjs:1128-1147`). Any dialog shown without an `animateTargetId` via `show()` -> `initVnode(true)` remained parked off-screen at `-10000px` behind its modal mask. In addition, renaming the override to `async initVnode(mount)` must return `super.initVnode(mount)` rather than discarding its `{vnode, ...}` payload (`src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs:849-851`).

## The Architectural Reality

- Design authority: `"Creates the vnode tree for this component and mounts the component... If getting there, we return the data from vdom.Helper: create(), containing the vnode."` (`src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs:840-850`) and `"If there is no animation target, we need to ensure that the initial offscreen positioning from .neo-floating gets reverted"` (`src/dialog/Base.mjs:1135`).
- `src/component/Base.mjs:2022`: `show()` invokes `me.startMountFlight(me.initVnode(true))` when `!me.vnode && !me.vnodeInitialising`.
- `src/dialog/Base.mjs:1128-1150`: `initVnode(mount)` reverts `wrapperStyle.left` and `wrapperStyle.top` to `'initial'` when `!me.animateTargetId` and delegates to `super.initVnode(mount)`.

## The Fix

1. Rename `Neo.dialog.Base#render(mount)` to `async initVnode(mount)` in `src/dialog/Base.mjs` and `return super.initVnode(mount)` so awaiting callers receive the superclass `{vnode, ...}` payload.
2. Cover both `!animateTargetId` and `animateTargetId` paths plus the returned superclass `{vnode}` payload (stubbed and real `initVnode(false)`) in `test/playwright/unit/dialog/ShowWithoutAnimateTarget.spec.mjs`.

## Decision Record impact

`none` — restores `Neo.dialog.Base` lifecycle override parity after `#7147`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A `Neo.dialog.Base` without `animateTargetId` reverts `wrapperStyle.left` and `wrapperStyle.top` to `'initial'` on `initVnode()`, while a dialog with `animateTargetId` preserves its off-screen parking until animation (`test/playwright/unit/dialog/ShowWithoutAnimateTarget.spec.mjs`, red on `dev`).
- [ ] `Neo.dialog.Base#initVnode(mount)` returns the superclass `super.initVnode(mount)` payload containing `vnode` in both stubbed lifecycle assertions and a direct unstubbed `dialog.initVnode(false)` call (`test/playwright/unit/dialog/ShowWithoutAnimateTarget.spec.mjs`).

## Out of Scope

- Remaining #21959 criteria: the `openEventEditor(id)` / `openTaskEditor(id)` no-rendered-bar unit witness (AC-2 of #21959) and the `examples/scheduler/eventEditor` + `examples/gantt/taskEditor` open-on-load frames, `lookFor` copy, `neomjs/pages` cover pairs, and design read (AC-3..AC-7 of #21959, actively coordinated with `@neo-gpt-emmy` under #21942).

## Avoided Traps

- **`await super.initVnode(mount)` without `return`:** Drops the `{vnode, ...}` payload promised by `VdomLifecycle#initVnode` (`RA-1` on #21991).
- **Closing #21959 from an engine-only PR:** Orphans AC-2..AC-7 before the two editor examples and covers land (`RA-2` on #21991).
